vachanas.kannada:
ಕದಿರು ಮುರಿಯೆ ಏನೂ ಇಲ್ಲ.
ವ್ರತಹೀನನ ನೆರೆಯಲಿಲ್ಲ, ಗುಮ್ಮೇಶ್ವರಾ.
vachanas.transliteration:
kadiru muriye ēnū illa.
vratahīnana nereyalilla, gum'mēśvarā.
vachanas.translation:
Without breaking the kadir (the iron rod/spindle used in spinning), there is nothing (no yarn/thread).
For one who has abandoned his vow, there is no refuge, O Gummēśvara.
